capabilities: Send single or multiple Markdown notes
Capture via the floating Draftava action
Retain clickable obsidian:// source links in imported ideas
extras: Desktop macOS only; Obsidian Mobile unsupported. Plugin is free but Draftava is a separate application with its own licensing. Creates temporary capture files outside the vault; remote images may be downloaded from their source URLs. Source links require the originating vault and file to remain available.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push selected text, notes, or images into the separate Draftava macOS app.

relations.evidence: Send selected text, Markdown notes, and images from Obsidian directly to Draftava.

summary: macOS plugin that sends selected text, Markdown notes, and images from Obsidian to the Draftava application.
